badge.name: Frontend Design with Cloud
badge.description: Recognizes the proctored in-lab React practical at the instructor-reviewed threshold.

criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M3A3 (In-lab React practical).

Award threshold: 75%.

m3a3: In-lab React practical. Built a small React application under proctored, closed-book lab conditions. The assessment covered JavaScript fundamentals, components and props, a controlled form, page composition, context and a custom hook, a real styling approach, theming, responsive layout, accessibility and code organization.
